We unpack a five-family taxonomy — business semantics & policy, identity/linkage (MDM), schema & pipeline, analytics & ML, governance & process — anchored in real-world outages. You’ll learn the signature failure modes (schema evolution gone wrong, CDC retractions, grain mismatches, missing consent flags), how to tag them for faster triage, and how to trace root cause with lineage so your post-mortems stop sounding like guesswork.
